idea-plugin.name: Claudex Autocomplete
idea-plugin.description:
Whole-method AI completion, no API key. Inline suggestions in your editor from the Claude Code or Codex CLI you already have installed and logged in, on the subscription you already pay for.

What it does

  • Whole bodies and methods. Press Enter in an empty method and get the full body. Type public function archive( and get the parameters, body and closing brace.
  • Mid-line and streaming. Suggestions also appear between existing code, and multi-line ones stream in line by line.
  • Alternatives. Alt+] / Alt+[ cycles up to 3 suggestions, requested only when you ask.
  • Next edit suggestions (opt-in). After an edit, it predicts the next one elsewhere in the file, such as the other uses of a renamed parameter. Tab jumps, Tab again applies.
  • Context that fits. The current file, the most relevant snippets of other open tabs and, for PHP, outlines of imported classes, parents, interfaces and traits.
  • Stays out of the way. No requests while you select text, use several carets, undo, expand a live template or browse the completion popup. Guards drop prose, loops and duplicated code.
  • Fast where it can be. Typing ahead reuses a suggestion, the next one is prefetched after you accept, and the Claude Code process stays alive.
  • Status at a glance. A status bar icon is grey when off, coloured when ready and blinking while thinking, with usage in the tooltip.

Requirements

  • An IntelliJ-based IDE, 2025.3 or newer (PhpStorm, IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm and others).
  • Claude Code (claude) with a Claude subscription, or Codex (codex) with ChatGPT, installed and logged in.

Usage and cost

Every suggestion is a request on your Claude or ChatGPT plan and counts toward its limits. Prefetch and next edit suggestions add requests; both can be turned off in settings.

Privacy

The plugin runs your local, unmodified CLI with your own login. It never reads or stores your credentials. Code around the caret, and optionally snippets from open tabs, goes to Anthropic or OpenAI through that CLI under their terms. Files that look like secrets (.env, keys, credentials) and VCS-ignored files are never sent. Nothing is sent until you enable completions.

Claudex Autocomplete is an independent, open-source project (GPL-3.0). It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Anthropic or OpenAI. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic; Codex is a trademark of OpenAI.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0

  • Whole function body when you press Enter in an empty body, and the whole method when a declaration line ends with (
  • Suggestions mid-line, with code right of the caret
  • Multi-line suggestions stream in line by line while the model writes
  • Alternative suggestions with Alt+] / Alt+[, up to 3, requested only when you ask
  • Next edit suggestions (opt-in): Tab jumps to the predicted edit, Tab again applies it
  • A dismissed suggestion survives typing, and the next suggestion is prefetched after you accept one
  • Related snippets from open tabs, ranked by the identifiers they share with the code at the caret
  • Quality guards: no prose, repetition loops, repeated lines or doubled closing brackets in suggestions
  • Smarter triggering: no requests with a selection, several carets, during undo, in live templates or while the completion popup is open (configurable)
  • Status bar icon without text, state and usage in the tooltip
  • Settings page regrouped by feature
  • Faster first suggestion: the Claude Code process starts with the project

1.0.0

  • Codex CLI as a second provider next to Claude Code
  • Spinner with elapsed time and status bar with request state and usage windows
  • Configurable file context, open tabs and PHP imported-class outlines
  • Custom prompt additions and a manual trigger action in the Tools menu
  • First-run consent: nothing is sent and no CLI is started before you enable completions
  • Secret-like and VCS-ignored files are never sent as context
  • Persistent Claude Code process, searchable settings and Plugin Verifier fixes

0.1.0

  • Initial release
  • Inline completions via Claude Code CLI or Codex CLI
  • Accept word, line or whole suggestion; manual trigger
  • Open tabs and PHP imported-class context
  • Status bar widget with usage windows
